scenario: [LTAC.5.4]: two timers from one `after` site fall due in the same tick, so their follow-ups are activations of one rule that complete together on that tick, and [LDET.5.5] orders them by their facts: the zone-1 timer entered working memory first, so its follow-up takes the lower timetag and `off 1` fires before `off 2`. Both Motions are asserted before one pump, so both timers are armed in one step with the same 5-minute deferral; one advance past it makes both due at once. PATH PINNED: libds holding the follow-ups' matches at the rule's last positive join when the tick completes them, and sorting them at the end of the event by `completion_key_cmp` (rete/beta.c); stamping them in join-walk order fired `off 2` first. Does NOT pin Mercury's sort, whose memories stay in insertion order and reach the older timer first either way (that is LDET.5.5_self_join). Does not pin ordering between two different rules' follow-ups, which is [LDET.5.4]'s.
rules_ds:
schema Motion scope logical:
    zone: Int key

rule arm:
    Motion m
->
    log info "armed {m.zone}"
    after 5_min:
        log info "off {m.zone}"
